description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `NusoapSoap` for implementing a SOAP server using the NUSOAP library within the SuiteCRM system. It manages SOAP request handling, WSDL configuration, and service registration, and it extends the base class `SugarSoapService`. The class includes methods for server setup, shutdown handling, service execution, type registration, function registration, class registration, and error handling.

classes.name: NusoapSoap
classes.description: An abstract class extending `SugarSoapService`, implementing SOAP server functionality using NUSOAP, responsible for handling SOAP requests, registering types and functions, and managing errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP server with the provided URL, configures WSDL, and sets up raw POST data handling.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Handles unexpected shutdowns, logs the event, and sends a SOAP fault message.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Processes incoming SOAP requests, manages output buffering, and triggers shutdown procedures.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Registers a complex type with the NUSOAP server for WSDL generation.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers available functions as SOAP services with NUSOAP, with support for 'use' and 'style' options.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Associates an implementation class with the server for handling SOAP method calls.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Sets the class name for registration purposes.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets a fault response on the SOAP server using the provided `SoapError` object.
